facts.claim: CTC describes Dial-A-Ride as door-to-door public transit open to any person in Clermont County and says all its buses are wheelchair accessible. Vehicle lift dimensions, weight limits and device fit are not stated on this page; discuss your equipment with dispatch.
facts.quote: Dial-A-Ride is a door to door public transit service. Passengers must call the Dispatch office and schedule a ride on a CTC bus. The service is open to any person in Clermont County. All buses are wheelchair accessible.

facts.claim: Reserve through dispatch at 513-732-7433, option 2, up to 14 days in advance. Trips are first come, first served; the scheduling office is open Monday–Friday, 5:30 a.m.–6:30 p.m. Booking does not guarantee a requested time.
quote: To schedule a ride, you can call UP TO 14 DAYS IN ADVANCE , trips are scheduled on a first come first serve basis. The scheduling office is open from 5:30 am to 6:30 pm Monday thru Friday.
Dispatch Phone Number 513-732-7433 – Press Option 2 to speak to Dispatcher

facts.claim: Dial-A-Ride operates Monday–Friday, 6 a.m.–6 p.m., with no Saturday service. The operator lists closures on New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day; severe weather may also close service.
quote: Dial-A-Ride service is available Monday thru Friday 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM (NOT SATURDAYS)
CTC will be CLOSED on the below days New Year’s Day Memorial Day Independence Day Labor Day Thanksgiving Day Christmas Day
In the event of severe weather, CTC may close it’s Dial-A-Ride service for safety if this happens information is submitted to all major broadcasting networks.

facts.claim: Pickup and destinations are within Clermont County. For travel outside the county, CTC can drop a passenger at a Metro bus stop inside Clermont County; Dial-A-Ride itself will not leave the county. Confirm the connecting service and transfer arrangements separately.
facts.quote: Passengers can be picked up anywhere in Clermont County and taken to any destination in Clermont County. If a passenger wishes to go outside Clermont County, CTC can drop them off at a METRO bus stop in Clermont County, but CTC will not leave the county.

facts.claim: Drivers may help passengers on and off the bus and help secure a wheelchair, but will not enter a home or business. This does not establish lifting, stair or personal-care assistance; agree the pickup location and assistance needed with dispatch.
facts.quote: The driver may help passengers on and off the bus and may help them secure their wheelchair, but under no circumstances will a driver enter a passenger’s home or business.

facts.claim: The bus may arrive up to 15 minutes before or after the scheduled pickup or drop-off time and waits five minutes at the pickup location. Allow for this window when planning appointments and outdoor waiting.
quote: The bus may arrive 15min before or after the scheduled pick up or drop off time.
The bus will wait 5 min at the pickup location.

facts.claim: Passengers may bring a service animal and up to four shopping bags; each additional bag costs $1. The page does not describe driver bag-carrying assistance.
quote: Passengers who have a service animal may bring it on the bus.
Passengers may bring up to 4 shopping bags on the bus, additional bags are $1.00 each.

facts.claim: The fare page lists one-way Dial-A-Ride fares of $4.75 for adults and $2.35 for people with disabilities or seniors. The disability/senior fare requires a CTC discount-fare application; exact change is required. Confirm eligibility and payment arrangements before travel.
quote: Dial-A-Ride Fares All fares are for a one way trip Adult $4.75 Student ( 13+ with a student ID) $3.75 Persons with Disabilities* $2.35 Seniors* $2.35 Children (12 and under) $2.35
To receive this fare you must fill out a discount fare application with CTC (PDF) Exact change is required

facts.claim: Cancel at least two hours before a booked ride to avoid a no-show. CTC says to call about an extreme situation so it can review the case individually; this Dial-A-Ride policy explicitly does not apply to its separate ADA paratransit service.
quote: If a passenger needs to call and cancel a ride, they must call CTC at least 2 hours in advance. If a passenger fails to call 2 hours in advance, they will receive a “ No Show .”
If a passenger does not cancel 2 hours in advance because of an “extreme situation,” they must call CTC. Cases will be handled in a case-by-case basis.
This policy is not applicable to Complimentary ADA Paratransit.
